thread.title: Dow Leads With Strong Gains; These 2 FANGs Hit All-Time Highs

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Leads With Strong Gains; These 2 FANGs Hit All-Time Highs
text:
The major market averages advanced higher midday Monday, extending Friday's solid gains as Netflix ( NFLX ) and Amazon.com ( AMZN ) rose to all-time highs in the stock market today. 
X The Dow Jones industrial average was the clear leader Monday, as it moved up 0.9% after reclaiming its 50-day moving average line Friday. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 rose about 0.6% apiece. The small-cap Russell 2000 was unchanged.
Volume was tracking solidly higher on the NYSE, but only slightly higher on the Nasdaq compared to the same time Friday.
Within the Dow industrials , Apple ( AAPL ) continued its recent stretch of gains with another nearly 2% gain Monday. Shares are nearing a new high after triggering a sell signal from a 176.34 flat-base entry in early February.
Elsewhere, General Electric ( GE ) hit a fresh multiyear low with an almost 2% fall. Shares are at levels not seen since October 2011 and are more than 50% off their 52-week high.
FANG stocks were outperformers Monday with Netflix ( NFLX ) leading the way, rising almost 3%. Shares hit a new all-time high and are up more than 40% from a 204.48 flat-base buy point. Meanwhile, Amazon.com ( AMZN ) advanced more than 1%, also hitting a new high. After falling to its 50-day line Feb. 9, the e-commerce giant has risen in nine of the past 10 sessions to new highs. Shares are up about 25% from a 1,213.51 flat-base entry.
